field_changes.old: Every order3k and every invariant delta twist gives S6 when the gamma numerator is n=+/-1. For gcd(n,3k)=1 the fundamental group and H1 through H4 are Z/abs(n), with exact specialization indices(3k,k,k,3k) and four d2=n. Every positive-diagonal filling with m=3k,n=+/-1 and arbitrary d has actual n*K angular clutch, return index0, class0, and product mapping torus. Its root-deck line winding is2mn; the exact M-complement subfan and regular-band graph-line comparison retain the entire finite-cap gauge. P3K.17 proves that the negative-diagonal filling of P3F.26 has the same actual zero return, including both charged caps and the additional fixed-locus boundary. The full explicit affine-cap freeness criterion is gcd(k,n,d)=1 and (3 does not divide n or 3 divides k). Every free cap has pi1=Z/abs(n), so the sphere sector is exactly n=+/-1; no additional sphere members occur among the non-coprime free caps. P3F.34 now proves all free-cap homology: for n nonzero the additional Z/g factor occurs in H2 and H3, with g=gcd(3k,n,3d).
